The `@Nullable` annotation indicates that the `reference` can be null. When the method is used in a production environment, where assertions are typically disabled, the method will not throw the exception, and any null `reference` will be returned without validation. The `@EnsuresNonNull` annotation indicates that the method guarantees the non-nullness of the returned value, which is a contract that is only true when assertions are enabled.
